descricao_original: This electron micrograph shows two macrophages with indented nuclei and ruffled plasma membranes. The mast cell seen here contains numerous electron-dense, secretory granules throughout its cytoplasm. Its spherical, central nucleus shows moderate, peripheral heterochromatin. 7000x
